_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Store Separation Methodology Plan
summary: Establishes the contractor's plan for accomplishing store separation analysis, predictions, and recommendations identified in MIL-HDBK-1763, Aircraft/Stores Compatibility: Systems Engineering Data Requirements and Test Procedures.
use_relationship:
The Store Separation Methodology Plan will be used to establish the contractor's plan for accomplishing store separation analysis, predictions, and recommendations identified in the MIL-HDBK-1763, Aircraft/Stores Compatibility: Systems Engineering Data Requirements and Test Procedures.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described by the contract SOW.

This DID supersedes DI-SESS-82230.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Store Separation Methodology Plan shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Store Separation Methodology Plan shall contain the following:

children.title: Freestream Database
children.content: This section shall describe the development of a freestream database to include the method of data collection, data ranges, data smoothing, and the use of tie-in runs.

children.title: Aircraft Proximity (Grid) Database
children.content: This section shall describe the development of an aircraft proximity (grid) database to include the method of data collection, database build-up procedure, symmetry assumptions, methods used, and sample comparison plots.

children.title: 6DOF Model Development
children.content: This section shall describe the development of the 6DOF model to include use of data inputs, such as freestream database, grid database, ejector modeling, and mass property information, to create the integrated trajectory modeling capability.

children.title: 6DOF Predictions to CTS Trajectories
children.content: This section shall describe the generation of trajectories to include database comparison, verification of critical 6DOF input data, validation of database assumptions, adjustments made to the grid database, and sample comparison plots.

children.title: Flight Envelope Analysis
children.content: This section shall describe the analysis of the flight envelope to include the range of flight conditions, store configurations, aircraft configurations, assumptions and interpolation methods, and sample flight condition plots.

children.title: Miss Distance Analysis and Predictions
children.content: This section shall describe the analysis of miss distances in the flight envelope to include the method of calculation and assumptions, sample miss distance plots, and the definition of critical minimum miss distance criteria.

children.title: Recommendation of Flight Test Points
children.content: This section shall describe the recommendations of flight test points to include the method of comparison for flight conditions and criteria for test point selection.

children.title: Recommendation of Safe and Acceptable Separation Envelope
children.content: This section shall describe the generation of the clearance envelope to include the definition of safe and acceptable separation criteria, use of miss distance conclusions, method of envelope generation, and sample clearance envelope plots.
